hard_gates: A retrospective cannot rewrite incident or delivery facts, assign personal blame, or create vague action items; every improvement needs evidence, owner, due date, measurable signal, and review condition.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
Continuous learning must link each confidence or priority change to current authorized evidence and preserve contrary evidence; repeated opinion, stale metrics, or correlation alone is not learning.
Reference retention never makes material current operational guidance; missing date, scope, provenance, applicability, or supersession status blocks adoption claims.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.

permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 3 related modes: Conduct a blameless engineering retrospective from fresh delivery, repository, test, plan, and outcome evidence and propose owner-bound improvements without changing records or systems.; Synthesize authorized runtime signals, customer feedback, experiment results, alerts, and residual assumptions into calibrated hypotheses, priorities, and the next learning cycle without collection or persistence.; Record source-linked reference or deferred material with applicability, freshness, supersession, and non-operational status without presenting it as current guidance.
